title: COMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Component operators, covering child operators, extensions, internal shortcuts, component layout, creating and copying operators, recursive searches, connection helpers, and child memory management.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs to build, copy, search, connect, or arrange operators inside a component.
Use create() for new child operators and copy()/copyOPs() when duplicating existing operators while preserving local network structure.
Use layout() after generated node placement when deterministic manual coordinates are unnecessary or after a bulk network edit.
Use findChildren() with type, name, tags, or parameter filters for recursive component searches instead of manual tree walks.
Check extensionsReady before accessing promoted extension members during initialization-sensitive workflows.
